issues.title: DINOv3 gated-weight acceptance
issues.detail: Meta/Hugging Face access is gated. Meta terms require the licensee to meet applicable legal-age requirements and include separate use obligations. Research-only use is authorized by the user, but the model access gate is not yet confirmed.
issues.next_action: Account holder must complete any required gated-access acceptance; do not download or use DINOv3 weights until access is granted.

issues.title: RETFound checkpoint-specific access
issues.detail: RETFound-MAE is accessed through the approved account and its CC BY-NC 4.0 frozen probe is complete. RETFound-DINOv2 exact file requests returned 403 GatedRepoError from both authenticated Mac and L4.
issues.next_action: Continue only with approved RETFound-MAE evidence; retry DINOv2 only after publisher approval.

issues.title: VisionFM research-only conditions
issues.detail: Official repository limits use to research and education and prohibits commercial use. This run is noncommercial; do not use it for a clinical decision service or redistribute its weights.
issues.next_action: Use only for internal research evaluation and preserve required attribution.

issues.title: Previously exposed external cohort
issues.detail: Zhejiang UWF was evaluated in the prior run and has diagnosis-vs-healthy labels rather than referable-grade labels. Results here are exploratory only.
issues.next_action: Do not label any rerun on Zhejiang as untouched external confirmation.

issues.title: EyeCLIP and RET-CLIP weight-license status
issues.detail: Official repositories provide or link weights, but an explicit weight license was not established in this screening. Code availability is not permission to use model weights.
issues.next_action: Keep listed as candidates; inspect official weight terms or obtain author permission before download/use.

issues.title: OPENEye-FM training-data provenance
issues.detail: Official model card lists 37 pretraining sources including DeepDRiD and DDR. These validation rows were excluded; the repository labels CSV was absent in the public checkout, so exact image-level overlap with DRTiD/HYGD could not be audited.
issues.next_action: Treat DRTiD/HYGD metrics as exploratory transfer only; do not call them independent confirmation.

issues.title: RFM and RETFound-Green weight terms
issues.detail: User confirmed Golden Retina has no commercial activity or commercial funding. RETFound-Green can be included for internal non-commercial research under its custom license. This does not establish rights for clinical/commercial deployment, sublicensing or redistribution of weights.
issues.next_action: Continue internal research only; keep base/derived weights and row-level outputs private; verify any future deployment or redistribution rights separately.

issues.title: EyeFound usable checkpoint availability
issues.detail: A paper is available, but a clearly official downloadable checkpoint with reusable terms was not confirmed.
issues.next_action: Do not allocate GPU training time unless an official weight release and terms are verified.

issues.title: Current-phase cloud spend control
issues.detail: Spend limit is ₺1,900 planned plus ₺80 protected reserve, ₺1,980 absolute operational ceiling. No elapsed-time cap. Billing is delayed and alerts are advisory; estimate is tracked conservatively.
issues.next_action: Continue with the VM while projected cumulative spend remains within ₺1,900; stop before the hard ceiling and retain the ₺80 margin.

issues.title: Disease-label coverage is narrower than all retinal diseases
issues.detail: The frozen manifest supports DR grade classification on DDR/DeepDRiD/DRTiD, HYGD glaucoma classification, and DDR image gradability. It contains zero labeled retinal-lesion rows and no AMD or retinal-vein-occlusion cohort.
issues.next_action: Run and report only supported tasks; do not imply an all-retinal-disease classifier. Seek/attach separately labeled disease cohorts only in a later authorized phase.

issues.title: Frozen manifest has no untouched test partition
issues.detail: The frozen 7,671-row manifest contains train and validation only (zero test rows). Prior Zhejiang and MMRDR-related cohorts are already exposed in project history and cannot be represented as independent confirmation.
issues.next_action: Use the frozen validation split only for candidate selection. At the held-out stage, use a genuinely new unused cohort if one becomes available; otherwise mark external confirmation unavailable and do not tune on exposed cohorts.

issues.title: Baseline checkpoint path and old VM time limit
issues.detail: The missing remote models/ directory was created, the optional trainer timeout was disabled, and the L4 baseline checkpoint/run were verified earlier in this phase.
issues.next_action: Historical blocker resolved; no remaining action.

issues.title: Duplicate DINOv2 probe process
issues.detail: A command-wrapper precedence mistake launched a duplicate against the same output path. The duplicate process was stopped promptly; the original single run completed and its aggregate result/checkpoint provenance were verified.
issues.next_action: Use explicit process-state verification after future background launches.

issues.title: Matched quality-control empty-target batch failure
issues.detail: The first no-quality control run stopped after epoch 1 when a batch contained only ungradable DDR images, leaving GradScaler without optimizer inf checks. No result from that failed attempt will be used.
issues.next_action: Skip batches without any disease or active quality supervision; restart in a fresh output directory.

issues.title: Source-invariance empty-supervision batch
issues.detail: Initial stage-29 run stopped after epoch 1 when a batch contained train-only DDR ungradable samples with no disease loss and no source-head label. The batch-skip condition now checks all three active objectives. Invalid first attempt is excluded.
issues.next_action: Restart from a fresh output directory and preserve the fixed script hash.
